title: Pre-Analysis — Reinforcement of the Inboard Flap Track No. 2 Rib Attachment

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Pre-analysis of the reinforced rib attachment at the wing rear spar, raised against fretting findings at the bolt pattern and closed after the published oversize bushing repair and the trailing edge harness runs were assessed.

sections.objective: Establish what the reinforced rib and revised bolt pattern do to aircraft that have already been repaired at the same attachment, and what has to move in the trailing edge to install it. The fretting findings that drove the change have been managed for several years by an oversize bushing repair, so a substantial part of the target population is not in the as-built condition the reinforcement assumes. Pre-analysis was asked to quantify that population and to say whether the reinforcement can be fitted over the repair.
sections.findings_summary: Four items were confirmed. The dominant one is the published oversize bushing repair for an elongated attachment hole, which is embodied widely and which enlarges the very hole the revised bolt pattern relies on; the reinforcement can be fitted, but only if the rib is machined to the repaired hole size, and that variant does not exist. The part list figure for the support structure carries the current rib and fastener set with no alternate. The trailing edge harness runs across the rib at two bracket stations and the wiring sheet requires re-support when a bracket station moves, which the revised pattern does. The flap position sensing operational test is called up as the closing check and its rigging tolerance is stated against the current rib datum, which shifts by a small but non-zero amount.
sections.next_steps: Ask the design office for a second rib variant machined for the repaired hole size, and quantify the repaired population before the retrofit is quoted so that the two variants can be ordered in the right proportion. Add an alternate item to the part list figure. Commission a re-support scheme for the two bracket stations. Re-state the rigging tolerance in the flap position test against the new datum and publish it with the bulletin.

similarity_seeds: fretting at a flap track rib attachment bolt pattern
oversize bushing repair of an elongated attachment hole

tasks.title: Quantify the repaired population at the same attachment
Review part list content for the support structure
Assess trailing edge harness bracket stations
Check the closing operational test rigging tolerance

expected_findings.rationale: The oversize bushing repair enlarges the attachment hole the revised bolt pattern relies on. A large part of the target population carries it, and the reinforced rib as designed cannot be pinned to a repaired hole.
expected_findings.resolution: Request a second rib variant machined for the repaired hole size and quantify the repaired population before quoting.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure carries the current rib and fastener set as a single configuration. With two rib variants and a revised fastener set it needs alternates rather than a substitution.
expected_findings.resolution: Add alternate items to the figure keyed to the rib variant.

expected_findings.rationale: The trailing edge harness crosses the rib at two bracket stations. The revised bolt pattern moves both, and the wiring sheet requires a moved bracket station to be re-supported rather than re-clipped.
expected_findings.resolution: Commission a re-support scheme for the two bracket stations before the bulletin is drafted.

expected_findings.rationale: The flap position sensing operational test is the closing check of the retrofit and states its rigging tolerance against the current rib datum. The datum shifts slightly with the reinforcement, so the closing check can fail on correct work.
expected_findings.resolution: Re-state the tolerance against the new datum and publish it with the bulletin.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares the flap system vocabulary and the trailing edge zones that the entity pass keyed on, but it isolates a position disagree indication arising from the sensing electronics. It shares no structural item with the rib attachment and is unaffected by the bolt pattern change.

type_data.conclusion: Closed with a positive position. The reinforcement is sound but needs a second rib variant for repaired aircraft, an alternate part list configuration, a wiring re-support scheme and a re-stated rigging tolerance.
